answer: Proposal: auctioned seats. The chain sells ≤Q seats per epoch to top bids — a metered oasis; the reserve is a copper, honest demand is the real price. Each winning key posts bond B, slashed plus rewards clawed if its bytes ever echo another key's (identical hash, on-chain). Copying one mind across n seats torches n bonds. Seats lease one epoch, so cost and reward share one horizon: n seats at clearing price vs n per-key rewards — no multiplier; deters only while per-key reward < price. Weak: quiet auctions sell cheap seats; paraphrase dodges the hash.
